title: Unit-class external cup products compare with projection pullbacks
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $X,Y$ be schemes over $k$ with structure morphisms $f,g$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Let $P=X\times_k Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product], $F=\mathcal O_X$, $G=\mathcal O_Y$, and $E=p_X^*F\otimes p_Y^*G$, using the restricted-scalar external cup operations [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $u_X,u_Y$ be the explicitly constructed degree-zero classes of the sections $1$ [lem-sc-scalar-unit-cohomology-coordinates]. There exist additive equivalences $e_X:H_k^1(X,F)\simeq H^1(X,\mathcal O_X)$, $e_Y:H_k^1(Y,G)\simeq H^1(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $e_P:H_k^1(P,E)\simeq H^1(P,\mathcal O_P)$ such that $e_P(a\boxtimes u_Y)=p_X^*(e_X(a))$ for every $a\in H_k^1(X,F)$ and $e_P(u_X\boxtimes b)=p_Y^*(e_Y(b))$ for every $b\in H_k^1(Y,G)$. The abelian groups and pullbacks are the recorded structure-sheaf cohomology [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. There is no bijectivity hypothesis on global structure ring maps.

proof.text: Apply the simultaneous module-to-abelian unit pullback comparison to obtain eX, eY and the unit-coefficient comparison on P.

The two adjoint tensor-pullback unit maps are isomorphisms. Tensor them and compose with the left unitor to construct m:E to O_P. Apply the recorded derived cohomology functor and restriction of scalars to asIso m; convert its linear equivalence to an additive equivalence c. Set eP to c followed by the unit comparison on P.

Rewrite the image of each external cup product under c with the scalar unit coefficient identities. Apply the pullback naturality formula to the corresponding projection. This proves both required formulas with the same constructed eP.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_external_cup_unit_comparison (k : Type u) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{u})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    let F := SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
    let G := SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf
    ∃ (eX : scalarCohomology f F 1 ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb X) 1)
      (eY : scalarCohomology g G 1 ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb Y) 1)
      (eP : scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) 1
        ≃+ Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f g)) 1),
      (∀ a : scalarCohomology f F 1,
        eP (externalCup f g F G 1 0 a (scalarUnitCohomologyClass g)) =
          structureSheafCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) 1 (eX a)) ∧
      (∀ b : scalarCohomology g G 1,
        eP (externalCup f g F G 0 1 (scalarUnitCohomologyClass f) b) =
          structureSheafCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) 1 (eY b))
